lead: Before Heidrun Code types a command in a terminal, it checks the command against these guards. A guard asks you to confirm the command, or forbids it. The guards of this project come first. Hardcoded guards come with Heidrun Code: turn one off for this project only.
noProject: No project is open. Select a workspace to see the guards of its project.
noProjectGuard: This project has no guard of its own yet.
addTitle: Open the window to add a guard to this project
switchLabel: Turn the guard {name} on or off for this project
